transcript.text: I reviewed the county health guidance for the pantry this week, and there are two key requirements that go beyond what's in our current draft. First, refrigerated food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, and the temperature must be logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open — our draft only proposes a weekly temperature check, which would not be sufficient. Second, the guidance requires that sealed packages display allergen labels. I have the printed guidance in my health-office binder and I'd like us to update the draft plan to reflect these requirements before we finalize it.
